terms.definitionEn: An element for embedding sound content with optional playback controls.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر لإضافة صوت للصفحة مع إمكانية إظهار أدوات التشغيل.

terms.definitionEn: An element for embedding moving-picture content, optionally with controls.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر لإضافة فيديو للصفحة وممكن يظهر أدوات التحكم.

terms.definitionEn: An empty element that names a media or image file for its parent.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر من غير وسم إغلاق بيحدد مورد صوت أو صورة للعنصر الحاوي.

terms.definitionEn: A void element connecting timed text such as captions to audio or video.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر من غير وسم إغلاق بيربط نصًا متزامنًا زي التعليقات بالفيديو أو الصوت.

terms.definitionEn: An element that embeds another browsing context within the current page.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيعرض سياق تصفح تاني جوه الصفحة الحالية.

terms.definitionEn: A container allowing browsers to choose among image sources before using an img fallback.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيسمح للمتصفح يختار بين مصادر صور مع وجود img كاختيار احتياطي.

terms.definitionEn: A bitmap drawing surface whose content is typically produced with scripting.
terms.definitionAr: مساحة رسم نقطية محتواها غالبًا بيتعمل باستخدام scripting.

terms.definitionEn: A container for scalable vector graphics that can be included directly in a document.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيجمع رسومات vector قابلة للتكبير وممكن يتحط جوه المستند مباشرة.

terms.definitionEn: A Boolean media attribute that asks the browser to provide playback buttons.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية منطقية بتطلب أدوات تشغيل وتحكم يوفرها المتصفح.

terms.definitionEn: A video attribute supplying an image to display before playback begins.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية للفيديو بتحدد صورة تظهر قبل بدء التشغيل.

terms.definitionEn: Timed text that includes spoken dialogue and relevant non-speech audio information.
terms.definitionAr: نص متزامن بيشمل الحوار ومعلومات صوتية مهمة مش كلام مباشر.

terms.definitionEn: Alternative material available when a browser cannot use an embedded element or resource.
terms.definitionAr: محتوى بديل بيكون متاح لو المتصفح ما قدرش يستخدم العنصر أو المورد المضمن.

questions.question: What does controls request for this audio element?
options: A caption track in the default language
An automatic download before playback
A text alternative for the sound
Browser-provided playback controls
questions.explanation: The Boolean controls attribute asks the browser to expose playback controls.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية controls بتطلب من المتصفح إظهار أدوات تشغيل الصوت.

questions.question: Which element is intended to embed moving-picture media?
options: The video element
The audio element
The track element
The source element
questions.explanation: video embeds video media; audio is intended for sound-only media.
questions.explanationAr: عنصر video بيضيف فيديو، أما audio فمخصص للصوت.

options: Shoreline at dusk

shore.mp4
Shoreline at dusk
No visible text
Shoreline
questions.explanation: The figure caption is visible text; the media source URL is not shown as page text.
questions.explanationAr: تعليق الشكل نص ظاهر، لكن عنوان ملف الفيديو مش نص معروض.

questions.prompt: Add browser playback controls to this sound clip.
questions.explanation: The controls attribute requests native playback controls.

questions.question: What does source contribute inside video?
options: It creates a caption visible below the player
It names a media file the browser can try
It replaces the video controls with a link
It gives the embedded player an accessible title
questions.explanation: source specifies a media candidate and can include its media type.
questions.explanationAr: source بيحدد ملف وسائط ممكن المتصفح يشغله وممكن يوضح نوعه.

questions.prompt: List an Ogg audio candidate inside the player.
questions.explanation: source lists a resource candidate for the parent media element.

questions.question: What does iframe embed in this page?
options: A vector drawing painted into the current text flow
A video file with a text caption track
A nested context with another document
An image chosen from responsive source candidates
questions.explanation: iframe embeds another document in a nested browsing context.
questions.explanationAr: iframe بيعرض مستند تاني داخل سياق تصفح متداخل.

questions.explanation: The caption is visible page text; the SVG title names the graphic for accessibility rather than ordinary page rendering.
questions.explanationAr: التعليق نص ظاهر، أما title داخل SVG فبيسمي الرسم للإتاحة مش كنص عادي في الصفحة.

questions.prompt: Attach a captions track to the video player.
questions.explanation: track associates timed text data with a media element.

questions.question: What information is a captions track intended to provide?
options: Dialogue and relevant non-speech audio information
A second video stream for an alternate screen size
A complete transcript embedded in the preview image
A navigation list to other media pages on the site
questions.explanation: Captions include dialogue and relevant sound information, often for viewers who cannot hear the audio.
questions.explanationAr: captions بتشمل الحوار والأصوات المهمة وبتفيد اللي ما يقدروش يسمعوا.

questions.prompt: Set a preview image for the video before playback starts.
questions.explanation: poster supplies a preview image displayed before video playback.

options:
Coast
North bay
North bay

wide.jpg
North bay
No visible text
questions.explanation: The paragraph is visible; a successfully loaded image does not display its alt value as visible text.
questions.explanationAr: الفقرة ظاهرة، والنص البديل للصورة مش بيظهر كنص لما الصورة تتحمل.

questions.question: How does picture use its child source elements?
options: It displays all candidate files in a vertical gallery
It converts each source URL into a caption
It replaces the required img fallback with video
The browser can select a matching image source
questions.explanation: picture allows the browser to choose a matching source, with img providing the fallback image.
questions.explanationAr: picture بيسمح للمتصفح يختار مصدر مناسب، وimg بيوفر الصورة الاحتياطية.

questions.prompt: Provide a fallback image within the picture element.
questions.explanation: An img child provides the image fallback for a picture element.
The figure caption is visible text, while the empty canvas has no fallback text to display.
questions.explanationAr: تعليق الشكل نص ظاهر، ومساحة canvas هنا مفيهاش نص احتياطي.

questions.prompt: Give the inline vector drawing a name for assistive technology.
questions.explanation: A concise accessible name can identify a meaningful inline SVG graphic.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the title attribute on this embedded document?
options: It sets the title element inside the embedded document
It grants the frame permission to run every script
It names the embedded content
It makes the embedded page the main document
questions.explanation: A descriptive title helps users identify the iframe's embedded content.
questions.explanationAr: عنوان وصفي بيساعد المستخدم يعرف محتوى iframe المضمن.

questions.prompt: Name the embedded document so its purpose is understandable to assistive technology.
questions.explanation: The title attribute provides a label describing the embedded browsing context.

questions.code: <canvas width="240" height="120">Sales chart: 12 in May, 18 in June.</canvas>
questions.question: Why include fallback text as a canvas child?
options: It offers fallback text if canvas is unavailable
It forces the browser to draw the chart without scripting
It makes the canvas bitmap scale as a vector
It replaces the width and height attributes
questions.explanation: Fallback content can communicate useful information when canvas is not rendered or supported.
questions.explanationAr: المحتوى الاحتياطي ممكن يوصل المعلومة لو canvas ما اتعرضش أو مش مدعوم.

questions.prompt: Identify this timed text resource as English subtitles.
questions.explanation: srclang identifies the language of the track's text.

questions.question: How do captions and subtitles support users of audio or video?
keyPoints: Timed text is synchronized with media
track can associate a WebVTT resource
questions.modelAnswer: Timed text can make media understandable to people who cannot hear it or prefer reading dialogue. Captions include relevant non-speech sounds, while subtitles commonly focus on spoken words and translation.

questions.question: How do picture, canvas, and inline SVG differ in typical use?
keyPoints: canvas is a script-drawn bitmap surface
Choose the element based on content and interaction needs
questions.modelAnswer: picture helps a browser choose among image resources, while canvas offers a bitmap drawing surface commonly updated with scripting. SVG describes vector graphics that scale cleanly and can be embedded directly in markup.

questions.question: What accessibility and security concerns should be considered for an iframe?
keyPoints: Give the embedded context a descriptive title
The frame creates a nested browsing context
questions.modelAnswer: A descriptive title helps users understand the purpose of the embedded browsing context. sandbox can restrict what embedded content may do, so grant only the permissions the feature actually needs.

questions.question: What should a robust media element provide beyond a media file URL?
keyPoints: Native controls or a usable equivalent
Captions or other appropriate text alternatives
Fallback or explanatory content where useful
Avoid relying on autoplay for essential information
questions.modelAnswer: A usable media experience needs controls and appropriate text support, such as captions for video. Provide helpful fallback or explanatory content and do not rely on autoplay to communicate essential information.
